verdict.rationale: Cline's own CLI scheduling docs say agents can run on cron schedules through the hub for recurring automations. Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session. The GitHub README separately mentions scheduling routines in the native app. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs, documented detail on managing schedules (listing, pausing, logs or failure handling).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: The CLI supports running agents on cron schedules through the hub. Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
